items.title: What Does Boeing (BA) Cutting 5% Of Its Commercial Workforce Mean?
items.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) plans to cut about 5% of its commercial airplane workforce after slower than expected production increases. The company linked the decision to revised output plans for its jet programs, aiming to align staffing with near term demand. Management said the workforce changes would focus on the commercial airplanes division rather than company wide reductions. items.title: Boeing to Cut Thousands as 737 Production Growth Stalls

items.title: Boeing (BA) Stock May Sit Below Fair Value As Record Jet Order Lands
items.summary: Boeing shares closed at US$173.40 after a multi year stretch where the price has fallen well behind the wider market. That drop puts fresh focus on what investors are really paying for the company’s earnings today. The stock is down 25.6% over 5 years, which raises the question of whether the current valuation still lines up with the earning power investors expect Boeing to deliver.
